No complete repository validator CLI/scanner/typecheck/build; invoked committed generator messageArguments validator plus existing ICU parser on the five scoped keys, per allocation.

context.role: display name of one reasoning-effort level, in the status strip's effort reading, the effort picker rows, the default-effort select and the /effort argument rows
context.tone: single plain word, capitalised as a menu item
context.length: One word; the status strip reading is a few cells wide.
context.note: The name of a rung on a model's effort ladder, ordered None < Minimal < Low < Medium < High < xHigh < Max. Use the word a reader would expect on a speed/quality scale, and keep the levels distinct from one another. The wire value behind it stays the lowercase English token and is never shown through this key.

checks.en: {count, plural, =1 {{count_display} wake armed} other {{count_display} wakes armed}}
checks.vi: {count, plural, other {{count_display} lịch thức dậy đã đặt}}

context.role: count clause naming how many scheduled wakes are armed, on the composer's wakes chip and as the trailing tally of the run panel's Wakes section
context.tone: short status clause, lowercase after the number, no trailing punctuation
context.note: A wake is a scheduled follow-up the agent set for itself; armed means it is set and will fire. One string serves both surfaces so they cannot drift. Provide every CLDR plural category the language needs.

placeholders.count: Numeric selector for CLDR plural categories. English uses exact =1 to preserve the original strict count === 1 branch; translators add their CLDR arms.
placeholders.count_display: Raw String(count), preserving the former JavaScript interpolation without rounding or grouping. Print this, not count.

context.role: cadence of a wake that fires a single time, in a wake row and inside the schedule sentences that quote a wake's repeat
context.note: Opposite of 'every {duration}'. It is embedded mid-sentence by other strings (for example 'keep as once'), so it must read as a lowercase adverb.

semantic_review.effort: Thấp / Trung bình / Cao are idiomatic ordered display labels; not wire identifiers, so glossary config-token retention does not apply.
semantic_review.wake_armed: lịch thức dậy uses glossary intransitive wake; đã đặt means the schedule is set, not a delivered wake.
semantic_review.cadence_once: một lần is natural lowercase cadence. Existing keep-as-once sentence is separately keyed as Giữ: chạy một lần; repeat formatter only reaches repeating branch there.
semantic_review.fit: Display labels have 4 / 10 / 3 Unicode codepoints; cadence has 7. No numeric maxCells/maxChars contract found in these five sidecars; linguistic multiword equivalents preserve meaning. No actual layout-fit proof.
